# TinyForge Game Tools

TinyForge Game Tools publishes focused browser tools for game designers and players.

## Free tools
- DropChance: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/dropchance/ — RNG/drop-rate probability calculator.
- Hard Pity Calculator: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/pity-calculator/ — models increasing-chance pity and guaranteed pulls.
- XP & Leveling Time Calculator: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/xp-time-calculator/ — estimates hours, sessions and weeks to an XP target.
- Game Economy Faucet & Sink Calculator: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/economy-sink-calculator/ — estimates daily currency creation, sinks and net pressure.

## Services
QuickForge Digital offers small scoped spreadsheet, calculator, presentation and digital-production services: https://nikos0207.github.io/tinyforge-tools/services/

## Source
https://github.com/NikoS0207/tinyforge-tools
